name: The Pox Cult
source: Mord Hive v0.5, pp.059-062 (The Pox Cult). Statlines from datasheets pp.060-061; equipment lists p.060; Nurgle Rituals p.062 (see spells.json); Blessings of Nurgle p.062. specialRules.name: Psyker
specialRules.description: A Plague Abbot is a Psyker and uses the Nurgle Rituals (see spells.json).

heroSlots.notes: Unnatural Strength: starts the game with the Strongman skill (Strength list). TODO: verify skill-table access.

specialRules.name: Unnatural Strength
specialRules.description: Starts with the Strongman skill from the Strength Skill list.

heroSlots.notes: Must start the game with one or more Blessings of Nurgle (bought at recruitment only; see specialRules) - the cost is on top of the 25 tn hire. TODO: verify skill-table access.

henchmenTypes.notes: Daemons of Nurgle; neither need nor use weapons/armour. Never gain experience. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: Cloud of Flies
specialRules.description: A Plague Bearer's close combat opponent suffers -1 to hit on all attacks.

specialRules.name: Stream of Corruption
specialRules.description: A shooting attack, range 6", Strength 3, no armour saves.

specialRules.name: Demonic
specialRules.description: A Daemon of Nurgle; never gains Experience.

specialRules.name: Immune to Poison
specialRules.description: Totally immune to all poisons and diseases.

specialRules.name: Daemonic Aura
specialRules.description: 5+ armour save (modified by Strength as normal), negated by blessed/force weapons and psychic powers. Their own attacks count as force/blessed.

specialRules.name: Daemonic Instability
specialRules.description: If taken out of action, banished/destroyed on a D6 of 1-3 (no injury roll). If the warband routs, each Plague Bearer takes a Leadership test or counts as destroyed.

henchmenTypes.notes: Devoted followers. Bought in groups of 1-5.
Shambling undead; may not have weapons or armour and suffer no penalty for it. Never gain experience. Bought in groups of 1-5.

specialRules.name: May not run
specialRules.description: Slow undead; may not run (but may charge normally).

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Not affected by psychology; never leaves combat.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Treat a stunned result on the Injury chart as knocked down.

specialRules: The Pox Cult. Dangerous to Know: a Pox-Cult warband may never hire any type of Hired Gun. | Blessings of Nurgle (bought for The Blessed on recruitment only, never later; the first is at the listed price, second and subsequent cost double): Stream of Corruption (shooting attack, range 6", S3, no saves; 25 tn), Cloud of Flies (close combat opponent suffers -1 to hit; 25 tn), Bloated Foulness (+1 Wound, +1 Toughness, -1 Movement; 40 tn), Mark of Nurgle (+1 Wound, immune to all poisons; 35 tn), Hideous (causes Fear; 40 tn). | Fetid Enforcer Equipment List prices Light Armour at 20 tn and Shield at 15 tn (the shared chart lists 15 and 5). | Min warband size 3, max 20. | Human models use the standard Human maximum profile (TODO: verify vs v0.5); Plague Bearers and Blight Victims never advance (null ceilings).
